answer: Agent identities must post onyx collateral — slashable and locked per identity — that any whistleblower can partly claim by proving two identities collude. The protocol publishes an atlas of attested identity links, making every pairwise relationship an independent attack surface. Running n clones forces a sybil operator to guard n(n-1)/2 hidden channels: bribes, key rotation, and timing discipline bought for one channel never protect another, so guarding cost grows as n squared and cannot be amortized. The bounty signal needs only one leak — a single tip burns the whole cluster.
